SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalDutyCount, COUNT(transfer_status) AS shiftApplyCount, COUNT(car_status) AS vehicleApplyCount FROM duty_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0
AND duty_date >= #{startTime} AND duty_date <= #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalDutyCount
,SUM(CASE WHEN check_in_status = #{checkInStatus} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusCount
FROM duty_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0
AND duty_date >= #{startTime} AND duty_date <= #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount
,SUM(CASE WHEN check_in_status = #{status} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusCount
FROM duty_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(duty_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount
,SUM(CASE WHEN transfer_status = #{status} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusCount
FROM duty_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(duty_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount
,SUM(CASE WHEN car_status = #{status} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusCount
FROM duty_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(duty_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month}
